participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the brother's twenty-first year, unmarked by any letter

story.body: You wrote Richard's twenty-one into the margin and that nothing was sent. The kept letter to Anne stayed where Sunday left it. You did not put a day on it.

title: Marked Richard's twenty-first in the almanac

participation.context: Asked for the list twice, asked about the porch, and named a fortnight.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read the ticket, called it near five pound, and did not ask to be paid.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

relations.note: the father's shops, unread as a demand
relations.quote: I am not asking you to pay it.

relations.note: three shops let run a year

story.body: You let Gilbert read the three sums twice. They meet at five pound if the pence are strict, and he called the sum near. You recognised fourteen and six and did not say you would pay it. You asked about the baker at the porch, got no answer, and told him you are for home in a fortnight. He told you to take a full purse and an empty face.

participation.context: Did the sum at the window and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the ticket read twice, and not a demand

story.body: You said the three sums aloud and they made five pound, which he had called near. You set Sunday's fourteen and six against the whittawer's line on the ticket. You paid nothing, and you did not name the day you leave.

title: Added the three debts aloud to five pound
